name: es30-hello-triangle
title: Hello Triangle
summary: Minimal complete ES 3.0 program: VBO + VAO + GLSL ES 3.00 program + glDrawArrays, validated against a CPU barycentric reference.
spec: ES 3.0 §2.12.1 Shader Objects, §2.12.3 Program Objects, §2.12.5 Vertex Attributes
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.3.4 Input Variables, §4.3.6 Output Variables, §4.3.8 Layout Qualifiers, §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers

api.glCreateShader: vertex + fragment shader created; compile status checked
api.glCreateProgram: program used for the validated draw
api.glBindBuffer: ARRAY_BUFFER binding captured by attrib pointers
api.glBufferData: vertex data observed through rendered colors
api.glGenVertexArrays: VAO used for the validated draw
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: both attributes sourced from the buffer
api.glVertexAttribPointer: interleaved stride/offset; stride read back with glGetVertexAttribiv
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLES; interior pixels match CPU reference
api.glViewport: full-surface viewport maps NDC to the probed pixels
api.glClearColor: corner pixels equal the clear color
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the default framebuffer

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi capture: upright triangle, R bottom-left, G bottom-right, B top, smooth gradients, dark-blue background.
